definitions.explanation: Extending a deadline, contract, subscription, or time limit beyond its original end date.
Making something physically longer, or the total length of something.
Extra time played in sports when a game is tied at the end of regulation.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}を{一年|いちねん}{延長|えんちょう}した。
examples.english: I extended the contract by one year.

examples.japanese: {図書館|としょかん}の{本|ほん}の{貸出|かしだし}{期間|きかん}を{延長|えんちょう}できますか。
examples.english: Can I extend the borrowing period for the library book?

examples.japanese: ビザの{延長|えんちょう}{手続|てつづ}きをしなければならない。
examples.english: I need to go through the visa extension procedures.

examples.japanese: この{道路|どうろ}の{延長|えんちょう}は{約|やく}10キロだ。
examples.english: The total length of this road is about 10 kilometers.

examples.japanese: {地下鉄|ちかてつ}の{路線|ろせん}が{郊外|こうがい}まで{延長|えんちょう}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The subway line is scheduled to be extended to the suburbs.

examples.japanese: {延長|えんちょう}コードを{使|つか}って{掃除機|そうじき}を{奥|おく}の{部屋|へや}まで{届|とど}かせた。
examples.english: I used an extension cord to reach the vacuum cleaner to the back room.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{延長|えんちょう}に{入|はい}った。
{延長|えんちょう}{戦|せん}の{末|すえ}、ホームチームが{勝|か}った。
examples.english: After overtime, the home team won.

examples.japanese: {延長|えんちょう}{十二回|じゅうにかい}の{熱戦|ねっせん}は、サヨナラホームランで{幕|まく}を{閉|と}じた。
examples.english: The heated battle that went into the 12th inning ended with a walk-off home run.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {延|えん} (extend, postpone) + {長|ちょう} (long). Literally "extending long."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{契約|けいやく}を{延長|えんちょう}する (to extend a contract)
・{期限|きげん}を{延長|えんちょう}する (to extend a deadline)
・{滞在|たいざい}を{延長|えんちょう}する (to extend one's stay)
・{会員|かいいん}{期間|きかん}の{延長|えんちょう} (membership extension)
・{延長|えんちょう}{料金|りょうきん} (extension fee)
・{延長|えんちょう}コード (extension cord)
・{延長|えんちょう}{戦|せん} (overtime game)

CONTRAST:
・{延長|えんちょう}: general extension (time, length, contracts)
・{延期|えんき}: postponement (moving an event to a later date)
・{更新|こうしん}: renewal (starting a new term)

USAGE NOTES:
・{延長|えんちょう}する is used when extending without changing fundamental terms
・For visas: ビザを{延長|えんちょう}する (extend a visa)
・For subscriptions: {自動|じどう}{延長|えんちょう} (automatic renewal/extension)
